walk.title: Get up and walk
walk.lead: A few minutes already count. Go to the window or get more water.
walk.step1: Stand up and leave the chair
walk.step2: Walk at your own pace, no rush
walk.step3: Refill your glass of water while you are up

neck-shoulders.title: Stretch neck and shoulders
neck-shoulders.lead: One minute already helps. You can stay seated.
neck-shoulders.step1: Tilt your head to each side, 10 seconds
neck-shoulders.step2: Roll your shoulders back 10 times, slowly
neck-shoulders.step3: Lace your fingers and stretch your arms up

eyes.title: Rest your eyes
eyes.lead: It is the 20-20-20 rule: 20 seconds looking far away.
eyes.step1: Take your eyes off the screen
eyes.step2: Look at something about 20 feet (6 metres) away

wrists.title: Loosen your wrists
wrists.lead: One minute, right where you are.
wrists.step1: Stretch one arm and pull the fingers back with the other hand
wrists.step3: Circle your wrists slowly, 5 times each way

back.title: Stretch your back
back.lead: One minute on your feet already helps.
back.step1: Stand up and lace your fingers above your head
back.step2: Stretch upward and take a deep breath
